items: 6 oz tomato paste + 2 cans (1½ cups) water

steps.title: Mix the dough
steps.body: Combine and mix, kneading as needed: **4 cups flour**, **2 Tbsp cooking oil**, **2 Tbsp baking powder**, **1½ tsp salt**, **2 Tbsp sugar** and **1¾ cups warm water**.

steps.title: Rest
steps.body: Let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Knead and roll
steps.body: Knead until smooth and elastic. Roll golf-ball sized pieces out to ¼" (about plate size).

steps.title: Fry
steps.body: Fry in hot oil until golden brown on both sides.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.body: Combine for the sauce: **1½ pounds hamburger**, **6 oz tomato paste** + **2 cans (1½ cups) water**, **2 cans chili beans** and **1 pkg taco mix** (about ¼ cup).

steps.title: Top and serve
steps.body: Place sauce on fry bread, and top with cheese, onion, lettuce, tomatoes, Tabasco sauce, olives and sour cream.
